title: Integrated Cell Browser
bodyHtml:
Integrated Cell Browser

Explore interactive visualizations of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and single-nucleus ATAC-seq (snATAC-seq) data from pancreatic islet cells.

Three major maps are currently available:

1. Single cell expression map of pancreatic islets using data from 65 human donors sourced from HPAP (scRNA-seq)

2. Integrated single cell expression map of pancreatic islets using data from 140 human donors sourced from HPAP, IIDP, and Prodo (scRNA-seq)

3. Single cell chromatin accessibility map of pancreatic islets using data from 41 human donors sourced from HPAP (snATAC-seq)

Within a selected dataset, visualize interactive plots of cell type clusters, gene expression, cell type abundance, and marker gene expression. Query a gene name and filter results using the desired parameters. Please be patient, as data may take some time to load. 

Detailed data processing methods are available for v1 and v3.3 of the integrated single cell expression map of pancreatic islets using data from HPAP, IIDP and Prodo. Descriptions are available here for traits that can be used to stratify cell count and gene expression plots.

Explore the underlying donor data, donor metadata, and data and metadata standards. Find quantitative trait loci (QTLs) of the queried gene through PanKgraph.

If you use data from this page, please review our Citation Policies to ensure proper citation of the underlying resource(s) used to generate these maps.
